one_big_idea: Saber Stamina: add a stamina resource to melee fighters (mirror of ranged AUTO_ATTACK_COMMIT slow) so melee gains movement+timing rhythm; ship it alongside a fixed Fourfold Verdict.

directives.title: Saber Stamina
directives.change: Add stamina/maxStamina to buildFighter; melee basics drain stamina; below floor, scale swing cooldown / pause auto until regen out of contact.
directives.acceptance: getSpatialSkillReadout exposes stamina for melee basics; continuous-swing loop measurably slows; npm run check:duel stays green.

directives.title: Ship Fourfold Verdict

directives.acceptance: Fourfold Verdict resolves as 4 dodgeable bands; Oathstar<->Moonthorn moves toward ~60% baseline without other pair breaching 80% bound; gate green.

directives.title: First step to FFA match mode
directives.change: Add deterministic N-fighter (2-8) step sharing one projectiles/effects world; start with 4-fighter FFA that boots and terminates.
directives.acceptance: Headless 4-Wordform FFA (melee+ranged mix) runs under 16ms tick, invariants hold, fight terminates; npm run check:duel stays green.

challenge_for_mikel: Saber combat needs a resource — stamina or heat? Ranged already has focus cost + per-shot move-slow (AUTO_ATTACK_COMMIT_SHARE). For melee I propose stamina (drains on swing, regens out of contact, forces movement-between-swings). You may prefer heat (builds while swinging, overheats and forces a vent). Decide: stamina or heat, and does it apply to all basics or melee-only? I will lock the constant and write Directive 1 around your answer.
lead_decision_honored: 2026-08-06 BOTH: melee sabers AND ranged projectiles first-class. Brief pushes melee from guest-class to parity via Saber Stamina + working melee signature; FFA directive builds toward both families coexisting in match mode.
